fusions.name: Buckler Slam
fusions.desc: A wing-first slam that deals 13 damage, pushes the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Wing Flap
fusions.desc: Beats a ring of wind that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wingfold
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 40%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
